title: The Business of Community course page reads its run dates from the events, so it cannot go stale

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: the sales page (/discover/journeys/the-business-of-community-101, which 308s to /courses/business-of-community) types 'Starts Thursday, January 7' and 'Thursdays, January 7 to 28' by hand (business-of-community.tsx:237,499,680). The four pilot session events exist in production (published, 7 to 28 Jan 2027, 10 AM Pacific, matching the page). After 7 Jan the page keeps saying it starts 7 Jan. Fix: read the next session from the events and switch the hero to the next run or the self-paced week 1 once the run starts.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
